get.description: Describe a provider, register, table, variable, set or classification by id or name (a set only by `set/<provider>/<register>/<slug>`; it carries each member's whole `segments` list, so no `segments` call per member is needed). A classification (`class/<family>`) or one of its versions lists its versions, each with its part and the versions it succeeds, and the variables that use them, each with its rows that carry the classification; `class` lists the classifications with their versions. No `ref` lists the providers, each with its registers. Variables show curated metadata, with the provider's text only as a fallback. `evidence=true` adds the provider's original texts, column names, curation locators and linked documents.

Describe a provider, register, table, variable, set or classification by id or name (a set only by `set/<provider>/<register>/<slug>`; it carries each member's whole `segments` list, so no `segments` call per member is needed). A classification (`class/<family>`) or one of its versions lists its versions, each with its part and the versions it succeeds, and the variables that use them, each with its rows that carry the classification; `class` lists the classifications with their versions. No `ref` lists the providers, each with its registers. Variables show curated metadata, with the provider's text only as a fallback. `evidence=true` adds the provider's original texts, column names, curation locators and linked documents.
The catalog's period span, the server version and the steward's presentation.
Which years a register, table or variable exists: per table its periods, gaps (with reason) and releases.
Compare a table's or register's columns at two periods: added, removed and changed (name, type, length, value set).
A document by hash: what it covers, an excerpt and, when available, the full text.
The bytes of a PDF document by its content hash, shown inline.
The documents about a register (including its tables and variables), table, variable or classification, or about any of a set's member variables.
Search the catalog's documents; without `q`, list them by title. `register` keeps that register's documents.

What a variable, table or register replaces, is replaced by or is derived from, with the date and the source's own note. `kind=derived_from` is the lineage. A set ref answers for all its member variables at once.

post.description: The MONA order file for a project_data.json on this data holder's tables: one file per table and delivery, with its columns, row keys, row filter, undeliverable periods and warnings; or `order_blocked` listing every problem.

What a project_data.json would order: per requested variable, the table, period and column name, the periods that cannot be delivered, the row keys and any warnings; or `order_blocked` listing every problem.
Check a project_data.json: every problem with its level. Always 200; `ok` is true when `order` would succeed.

get.description: Find the variables behind column names (up to 200), optionally in one register. Names that match nothing are reported as unmatched.
The columns of a table, a register or a variable's tables over a period, with type, length, value set and role.

Search registers, tables, variables, codes and documents by text, best match first. A hit matches every word of `q`; when nothing does, hits matching the most words come first. `tag` keeps only that tag's variables. For exact column names use `resolve`.

A variable's columns over time: per table, column name and period one row, in time order, with the provider's wording and the form (type, value set, flags) where stated. A change of form or wording starts a new row. On a data holder's catalog, also its columns and files over the years it holds. A table ref with `variable` (up to 200 variables) lists those variables' rows in that table, in one list. `evidence=true` adds the deliveries behind each row and the curated values that replaced the provider's.

The codes and labels of a value set, by `value_set` hash or `classification`. `parent` steps through a hierarchy one level at a time; `q` searches it. Or give `code` (and `label`) to find the value sets that contain it. The blank code is a code like any other. `compare` with `classification` lists the codes added, removed and relabelled from the `compare` version to the `classification` version.

binding.description: The variable's position in the source; null for a row key nobody requested.

spelling.description: The catalog's column name; the file uses `name`.

oneOf.description:
The hull of the periods served: in steward mode the years held, else the
registers' periods. A timeless period does not count; an ongoing one leaves

hull is open at both ends.

One field that differs between the two periods: `spelling`, `type`, `length` or

path.description: An RFC 6901 pointer into the project; empty for the whole document.
